|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Derek 'Hobbie' Klivian (V) (Virtual Block 7)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB7-p5-105-Derek_Hobbie_Klivian-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Virtual Block 7.3 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Derek 'Hobbie' Klivian (V) (Virtual Block 7)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Derek 'Hobbie' Klivian (V) (Virtual Block 7)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011; the surviving copy was re-made 25 July 2011), Light Side p. 5: “[Pilot] 2. While piloting Rogue 4 (or any X-wing), draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Permanent weapon is Rogue Blaster (may target a character or creature for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 > defense value).”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of June 3, 2011"; the surviving copy was re-made 25 July 2011). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 7). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Derek 'Hobbie' Klivian (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “it's forfeit” for “its forfeit”, drops the comma after “target hit” and writes “X-Wing” (it also writes the pilot icon out as “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots”): “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting Rogue 4 (or any X-Wing), draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Permanent weapon is Rogue Blaster (may target a character or creature for free; draw destiny; target hit and it's forfeit = 0, if destiny + 1 > defense value).”.<ref name="cl-1273_24-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of 14 March and 16 May 2013 carry no game text</ref>
